tasks.title: Allow safe sequential packet replans
tasks.objective: Extend failed-task replan eligibility after a newer owner resolution while preserving exact revision CAS, replan request idempotency, immutable lineage, and concurrent loser rejection.
tasks.test_seam: Add red lifecycle tests for a second replan after a newer human decision, stale active revision, reused decision, concurrent distinct replans, three-entry active lineage resolution, and identical-request replay. Snapshot state bytes on every rejection.

tasks.title: Independently evaluate sequential replan safety
tasks.objective: Try to falsify sequential replan eligibility, freshness of human decisions, active revision compare-and-swap, request idempotency, concurrent serialization, and multi-entry lineage resolution.
tasks.test_seam: Independently exercise the registered lifecycle cases and verify no rejected request mutates authoritative state, packet lineage, attempt history, or authorization history.
